meta.name: caveman-compress
meta.description: Compress a memory file such as CLAUDE.md or a todo list into caveman format to save input tokens, keeping a readable backup. Trigger: /caveman-compress.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把记忆文件压成精简格式,省下输入字数并留一份可读备份
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次对话都因记忆文件太长而挤占上下文空间。
copy.tagline_en: Shrink memory files to a compact format to cut input tokens, keeping a backup.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if long memory files keep eating your context window.

howto.what: 装上后,对某个文件运行 /caveman-compress,它会把 CLAUDE.md、todo、偏好设置等自然语言文件改写成「原始人语」,以减少输入 token。压缩版直接覆盖原文件,可读备份存到源码目录之外的数据目录里。
howto.when: 当你输入 /caveman-compress <文件路径>,或要求压缩某个记忆文件时接管。只处理 .md、.txt、.tex 等自然语言文件,代码类文件不改。

say.note: 原文件被覆盖,可读备份存到数据目录

say.text: 把 ./todo.md 压成 caveman 格式

say.note: 出错时会定向修复,最多重试 2 次

howto.what_en: Running /caveman-compress on a file rewrites CLAUDE.md, todos or preferences into caveman-speak to cut input tokens. Compressed text overwrites the original; a readable backup is stored outside the source tree.
howto.when_en: Triggers on `/caveman-compress <filepath>` or when you ask to compress a memory file. Only natural-language files like .md, .txt are handled; code files are never modified.

say_en.note: Original overwritten; backup in data dir
Retries up to 2 times on errors
